cases.title: Existing shop types, orders, wallet, dealer / referral, registration unaffected

how.local: full vitest suite on PostgreSQL 18
how.test: staging queue guest QA + signed regression subset

local.evidence: full vitest suite on PostgreSQL 18: 287 files, 3,574 tests passed, 0 failed (2,881 s); Puja + tile-board + migration-journal re-run 71/71

test.evidence: After Puja (staging f1db94be, 18.21–18.40 IST), the same 14 signed-in specs as the 12.46 / 13.55 IST baselines. Run 1 (orders, cancel, wallet, cart, discovery, referral, dealer, registration): 57 passed, 19 skipped, 6 failed (baseline 46 / 29 / 7). Run 2 (bulk upload, product setup, catalogue, fulfilment, delivery OTP, COD): 47 passed, 19 skipped, 7 failed (baseline 24 / 46 / 3). None of the 13 failures is caused by Puja code: TC-ORD-006/010/011/012 and TC-FUL-003 — cancelling restocks the untracked newspaper listing "The Times of India" that shop A got at 17.01 IST (order-cancel code, not Puja; see notes); TC-FUL-007/009 — that ₹6 newspaper is now the "packaged" listing the substitution checks use; TC-CART-002, TC-DISC-007 — shop A's Butter Cookies at 0 stock / unavailable (drained by concurrent test runs); TC-COD-001/002/012 — the test customer is at the open-COD limit (as in the baseline); TC-CAT-083 — Puja's own QA products (rejected in review) at the top of shop A's My products file: listings removed 18.44 IST, the check then passed (PUJA-D-05). Search verified by hand: Bread 4, Butter Cookies 1, kapur 6 results.

cases.title: Smoke: site answers, post-deploy check, guest QA + puja guest checks
End-to-end with a test shop and test customer; test data marked / cleaned

defects.summary: Owner setup screen showed 0 items per category: a correlated subquery bound to products.id in a single-table query
defects.fix: outer column written fully qualified (src/server/puja/service.ts); integration test asserts the counts

defects.summary: /puja crashed with ORDER BY position 0 when no festival is live
defects.fix: festival ordering only added when a festival runs

defects.summary: Queue paused: QA harness require() race on next-auth/jwt (not this feature)
Queue failed #427 on TC-RBAC-002 / TC-AUTH-033: "/puja → 200". /puja is public by design, but the QA suite's PUBLIC_PAGES list (tests/qa/lib/routes.ts) did not include it. Test list, not app
defects.fix: PR #437 (staging-fix): /puja added to PUBLIC_PAGES; the check re-run on test.gokesari.com 18.18 IST: 230 pages, all refused

defects.summary: Puja QA left its own products (rejected / merged in review) listed in shop A; the setup-upload check takes its known Product IDs from the top of shop A's My products file and the upload accepts approved products only
defects.fix: TC-PUJA-013 removes the two QA listings at the end; staging listings removed 18.44 IST; TC-CAT-083 then passed

defects.summary: TC-PUJA-012 could not run twice on one site: its Hindi / Marathi type name was fixed, and the previous run's approved type made it an exact duplicate (correct app behaviour)
defects.fix: the run suffix goes into the local names; TC-PUJA-012 clears its stash first so TC-PUJA-013 never reviews an earlier run's products

Test data left on test.gokesari.com shop A (E2E Four Features Bakery): 37 puja listings (kapur and flowers), one priced hibiscus listing, QA Puja Type / QA Puja Dhoop <run> (approved / rejected / merged in review), orders DB-20261120-0RV9GQ (delivered) and DB-20261120-ETT6PT (cancelled, refunded); FSSAI rule restored, the QA festival collection switched off.

Found while testing, not part of Puja: cancelling an order puts stock back on every line (src/server/services/orders.ts, restock on cancel) without checking track_inventory, while checkout does not take stock from an untracked listing; shop A's untracked newspaper listing went from 11 to 65 this afternoon (61 cancels since 17.04 IST). Code from October; proposed as its own fix.

Found while testing, not part of Puja: the bulk setup upload accepts approved products only, so a shop's own products (pending or rejected in review — 17 pending ones on the test site before Puja) cannot be updated by re-uploading the shop's My products file ("not in the GoKesari product list"). Owner decision whether own products should be accepted there.
